patch_metadata.author: System Validation Team
patch_metadata.changes_summary: Fixes 3 P0 blocking defects identified in validation checkpoint analysis: (1) Missing deduplication matrix validation (13 overview-to-bullet checks), (2) Missing baseline similarity validation (K.5B/K.6B to master overviews), (3) Missing K.1 sentence structure validation (6-sentence arc enforcement). Excludes K.1 word count issue (deferred to v1.0.6 enhancement).
patch_metadata.execution_instructions: Apply patches in sequence C001 → C002 → C003. Run unit tests after each patch. Run regression suite after all 3 patches. Run E2E suite as final validation. All tests must pass before deployment.

defects_addressed.title: Missing Deduplication Matrix Validation
defects_addressed.description: QA Report states 'Deduplication matrix thresholds MUST be enforced' but provides no similarity scores for 13 required checks (7 K.5B-to-K.5A bullets + 6 K.6B-to-K.6A bullets)
defects_addressed.impact: Cannot verify paraphrasing vs synthesis in overviews, may generate redundant content
defects_addressed.root_cause: Validation gate VG_OVERVIEW_DEDUPLICATION exists in workflow but does not output validation table in QA report
defects_addressed.fix_scope: Add QA report table generation for overview-bullet deduplication scores

defects_addressed.title: Missing Baseline Similarity Validation
defects_addressed.description: v1.0.5 requires strict <0.75 cosine similarity between K.5B/K.6B and master baselines, but QA report does not include this validation table
defects_addressed.impact: Excessive similarity to original resume undetected, reduces customization effectiveness
defects_addressed.root_cause: Baseline comparison logic missing from QA report generation despite being in validation gates
defects_addressed.fix_scope: Add QA report table for overview-to-baseline similarity checks

defects_addressed.title: Missing K.1 Sentence Structure Validation
defects_addressed.description: v1.0.5 requires 6-sentence narrative arc in executive summary, but QA report only validates 'Industry-first opening compliant' without sentence-level structure check
defects_addressed.impact: Executive summary may use bullet-like content vs narrative synthesis, reduces persuasive power
defects_addressed.root_cause: Sentence structure enforcement exists in creative_brief but not validated in QA report
defects_addressed.fix_scope: Add sentence structure validation to K.1 QA checks

patches.description: Adds comprehensive deduplication matrix validation table to QA report showing all 13 overview-to-bullet similarity checks
patches.rationale: Current QA report omits overview-bullet deduplication scores despite workflow requiring this validation. Without these scores, cannot verify that overviews are thematic syntheses rather than paraphrased bullets.

existing_config.description: Shows 3 highest similarity scores between overview and bullets as proof of thematic distinction

current_state.problem: Only shows top 3 scores, not all 13 required checks. Does not enforce MUST validation per v1.0.5 spec.

overview_deduplication_detail.description: Validates all overview-to-bullet similarity checks per v1.0.5 deduplication matrix requirements

validation_enforcement.error_message_template: Overview-bullet deduplication FAILED: {section} {overview_vs_bullet} similarity {cosine_score} exceeds threshold {threshold} by {excess}. Overview appears to be paraphrasing bullet content rather than providing thematic synthesis.

validation_checkpoint.validation_logic: QA report MUST contain overview_deduplication_detail table with 13 rows (7 K.5B + 6 K.6B)
validation_checkpoint.pass_criteria: Table exists AND row_count == 13 AND all cosine_scores < 0.60
recovery_steps: Verify K.5B and K.6B overviews exist
Re-run deduplication analysis with verbose logging
Check for cosine similarity calculation errors

rollback_instructions.data_loss_risk: NONE - only affects QA report display

patches.description: Adds overview-to-master-baseline similarity validation table to QA report enforcing <0.75 strict boundary
patches.rationale: v1.0.5 introduced strict <0.75 (not ≤0.75) boundary for overview similarity to master baselines. QA report must validate this to ensure customization effectiveness.

current_state.problem: No overview_baseline_similarity table exists despite validation gate requiring it
current_state.gap: Validation gate exists but QA report does not display results

overview_baseline_similarity.description: Validates K.5B and K.6B similarity to master resume baseline overviews per v1.0.5 strict boundary requirement

K.5B_to_Unify_Baseline.pass_note: Score of exactly 0.75 is TOO SIMILAR and FAILS

K.6B_to_IBM_Baseline.pass_note: Score of exactly 0.75 is TOO SIMILAR and FAILS

validation_enforcement.error_message_template: Overview-baseline similarity FAILED: {section} similarity {cosine_score} violates strict <{threshold} boundary. Overview is too similar to master resume. Regenerate with higher differentiation.
validation_enforcement.missing_baseline_message: Cannot validate overview customization: Master baseline not extracted. Clerk phase must extract original overview text for comparison.

overview_baseline_similarity.boundary_clarification: Similarity score of exactly 0.75 (75%) is considered TOO SIMILAR and will FAIL validation. Must be strictly less than 0.75.

validation_checkpoint.validation_logic: QA report MUST contain overview_baseline_similarity table with 2 rows (K.5B + K.6B)
validation_checkpoint.pass_criteria: Table exists AND row_count == 2 AND all cosine_scores < 0.75 (strict)
recovery_steps: Verify K.5B and K.6B overviews exist
Re-run baseline similarity calculation with verbose logging
If baselines missing, halt and request master resume re-upload

2. Validation gates will still enforce boundary but won't display in report

sentence_count.error_if_not_6: K.1 must contain exactly 6 sentences per narrative arc requirement

industry_first_check.requirement: Industry/sector term MUST appear before any technology term
